انقبضوا (form VII)
# اِنْقَبَضُوا (inqabaḍū) /in.qa.ba.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# اِنْقَبِضُوا (inqabiḍū) /in.qa.bi.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
